features.name: Context-Aware Home Screen
features.description: Display time-aware context profiles (WORK, EVENING, SLEEP, ALL) with automatic time switching, manual filter chips, and onboarding setup card.
features.evidence: Implemented in HomeScreen.kt, LauncherViewModel.kt, PreferencesRepository.kt; debug APK builds and unit tests pass.

features.name: Command Bar Engine
features.description: Support prefix-prioritized app search, inline math evaluation, and '! <note>' quick to-do capture.
features.evidence: Implemented in CommandBarEngine.kt; verified by CommandBarEngineTest.kt via gradle testDebugUnitTest.

features.name: 5-Second Gentle Friction Dialog
features.description: Show a 5-second mindful pause dialog with today's foreground usage minutes via UsageStatsManager before launching distracting apps.
features.evidence: Implemented in FrictionDialog.kt, AppRepository.kt, LauncherViewModel.kt; verified in debug build.

features.name: App Drawer and Zero-Telemetry Settings
features.description: Provide searchable App Drawer with per-context pinning and friction toggles, plus Settings screen for auto-context and system permissions.
features.evidence: Implemented in AppDrawerAndSettings.kt and MainActivity.kt; verified in debug build.

features.name: Automated UI and Repository Test Coverage
features.description: Add Compose UI tests (HomeScreen, GentleFrictionDialog, SettingsScreen) and PreferencesRepository instrumented/unit tests.
features.evidence: Added StillnessLauncherUiTest.kt (5 Compose UI tests) and PreferencesRepositoryInstrumentedTest.kt (4 repository persistence tests); verified 9/9 passing on JSN-L22 via connectedDebugAndroidTest alongside testDebugUnitTest and assembleDebug.

features.name: Fix AppDrawerScreen Nested Scroll Layout
features.description: Replace nested verticalScroll + LazyColumn in AppDrawerScreen with a single bounded scrollable layout to prevent Compose measurement crashes.
features.evidence: Removed outer verticalScroll in AppDrawerScreen and bounded LazyColumn with Modifier.weight(1f).fillMaxWidth() + imePadding() in AppDrawerAndSettings.kt; verified via init.ps1, lintDebug, and live device launch.

features.name: Pro Unlock and v2 Context Triggers
features.description: Implement one-time Pro unlock split and optional Wi-Fi/location context triggers once product decisions in PRODUCT.md are finalized.

features.name: Active Anti-Addiction Gentle Friction System
features.description: Upgrade Gentle Friction with HomeScreen launch interception, daily open count & resisted counter, breathing circle animation, 1-tap intention chips, long-press friction toggle, and post-session reflection nudge.
features.evidence: Implemented in LauncherModels.kt, AppRepository.kt, PreferencesRepository.kt, LauncherViewModel.kt, FrictionDialog.kt, HomeDialogs.kt, HomeScreen.kt, MainActivity.kt; verified via init.ps1 (testDebugUnitTest + assembleDebug), lintDebug, and connectedDebugAndroidTest (10/10 passed on emulator-5554).

features.name: True Context-Aware Home Screen & Focus Timer
features.description: Render per-context Favorites (WORK/EVENING/SLEEP) with per-profile ordering, add Home Context & 25-minute Pomodoro Focus strip (restricting non-Work apps via Gentle Friction during focus), and add zero-permission local triggers (charging after 21:00 or DND -> SLEEP, monochrome icons in SLEEP).
features.evidence: Implemented in LauncherModels.kt, AppRepository.kt, PreferencesRepository.kt, LauncherViewModel.kt, HomeScreen.kt, AppDrawerAndSettings.kt, MainActivity.kt; verified via init.ps1 (testDebugUnitTest + assembleDebug), lintDebug, and connectedDebugAndroidTest (11/11 passed on emulator-5554).

features.name: Custom Context Profiles & Per-Context App Picker
features.description: Allow users to create/delete custom context profiles (with optional monochrome icon mode) and batch-select apps for any built-in or custom context directly from HomeScreen.
features.evidence: Implemented CustomContextProfile in LauncherModels.kt, JSON persistence in PreferencesRepository.kt, ViewModel actions in LauncherViewModel.kt, ContextAppPickerDialog & CreateCustomContextDialog in HomeDialogs.kt, and HomeScreen/MainActivity wiring; verified via init.ps1, lintDebug, and connectedDebugAndroidTest (12/12 passed on emulator-5554).

features.name: Rich Context Mode Editor (Triggers, Restrictions & Actions)
features.description: Upgrade both built-in (WORK/EVENING/SLEEP) and custom contexts with a full Mode Editor inspired by Samsung Modes & Routines: color presets, auto-triggers (headphones/Bluetooth, charging, time range), app usage restriction (5s friction on non-mode apps), hide notifications, monochrome icons, OLED pure black background, and mute media on enter.
features.evidence: Implemented BuiltInContextConfig & CustomContextProfile in LauncherModels.kt, AppRepository.kt, PreferencesRepository.kt, LauncherViewModel.kt, HomeDialogs.kt (ContextSwitcherSheet + ContextModeEditorSheet), HomeScreen.kt, MainActivity.kt; verified via init.ps1, lintDebug, and connectedDebugAndroidTest (15/15 passed on emulator-5554 only).
